locations.name: 01 · Underground airlock & decontamination

locations.name: 05 · Hacker operations

locations.name: 06 · Power & signal engineering

locations.name: 07 · Server archive vault
locations.description: Walk the rack aisles and inspect the archive terminal with Echo. Ordered quest checkpoints record your progress.

locations.name: 08 · Extraction & uplink
locations.description: Confirm the evacuation manifest at the extraction terminal. The Commons return gateway remains available.
